svg.title: County-level coronary heart disease prevalence
svg.desc: 2022 age-adjusted prevalence estimates by county in the United States.
svg.text: 2022 age-adjusted estimate • Percent of adults • CDC PLACES 2024

path.title: Lower Connecticut River Valley Planning Region, Connecticut: 4.9%
South Central Connecticut Planning Region, Connecticut: 5.2%
District of Columbia, District of Columbia: 4.7%
St. John the Baptist Parish, Louisiana: 6.6%
Lake of the Woods County, Minnesota: 6.0%
Prince of Wales-Hyder Census Area, Alaska: 7.7%

svg.text: Alaska and Hawaii are shown in separate insets at different scales; the Hawaii inset focuses on the main islands.
Source: CDC PLACES 2024, 2022 model-based estimates; U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb county boundaries (2026).
Estimates are for diagnosed coronary heart disease among adults; not individual risk or evidence of causation. See data-sources.md and qa-report.md.
